name: amazon
description: Estimate-only fee profile for an individual (pay-per-item) US Amazon seller. Copy and edit this file; nothing platform-specific is hard-coded.

category_overrides.note: Media categories use referral fees in this range; media sets vary.
Very high referral rate on Amazon's own devices.

notes: The 15% referral fee is the most common rate; real rates run from 8% to over 45% depending on category. The 0.99 order fee applies to individual (non-Professional) sellers; Professional sellers pay a monthly fee instead, so set order_fee_flat to 0 and budget the monthly cost yourself.
disclaimer: Fee rates change often and vary by category, plan, and fulfillment (MFN vs FBA). FBA fulfillment fees are NOT modeled here; add them into item_cost or shipping_cost yourself. This file is an editable pattern, not official data; check Amazon's fee schedule.
